# v2.0.0: Demos that prove their changes, finished in ChatGPT, with beginner guides

Webapp Capture now records real product flows (dragging, picking, confirming) and proves every change it makes. A recorded demo can be handed to ChatGPT, which adds an ElevenLabs voice, an intro clip from free stock footage or a Replicate video model, and the final stitch. Six step-by-step guides take a first-time user from installing the Claude desktop app to a finished, sellable video.

## Added

- Demo actions for real app flows: select, check and uncheck, pointer drag, native drag and drop, scrolling inside calendar grids and other containers, waiting for live state, and confirming dialogs only when their text matches the plan.
- A write ledger: every data change is declared, approved one by one, checked read-only afterwards, and remembered across takes. Reruns that would repeat changes are refused until you choose to retake.
- Privacy review: masked email, phone and redaction-pattern hits per scene, plus contact sheets for a person to check every frame.
- An editable cut list with an end-frame hold, scene titles, a narration fit report, and Eleven v4 clip texts (one per caption line, domains spelled out).
- `/webapp-capture handoff` and `finish_video.py`: package a reviewed demo for ChatGPT, then place each voice clip at its caption time behind an intro and shift the captions to match.
- The `demo-intro-video` skill and a bundled Replicate video MCP server (seven models, a read-only doctor, frame review), plus ChatGPT desktop manifests.
- Easier Replicate token setup: a private field in Claude Code, or `set_token.py`, which saves the token with hidden typing to an owner-only file.
- Six beginner guides, tables of contents, common prompts, pricing and selling guidance for Upwork and Fiverr, free B-roll sources, and a branded PDF with a clickable contents page.

## Improved

- The default cut starts when the page begins loading and ends at the true end of each clip, measured with ffprobe.
- The recorder never waits for network idle, so realtime pages no longer hang.
- The guard judges drag targets and dropdowns by their own name, so busy calendar columns are not refused for their contents.
- `doctor` warns when output paths repeat the config folder and suggests the fix.

## Safety

- The built-in deny list, credential-field refusal, plan approval, off-origin block and masks all still apply. A plan's deny pattern only adds to the list.
- Demo outputs are owner-only and are never written through a symlink or hard link. The ChatGPT handoff refuses unreviewed demos.
- Tokens never pass through a chat, and the doctor never prints them.

## Requirements

- The Claude desktop app (Code tab) on a Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise plan, or Claude Code in a terminal
- Node.js 20.9 or newer, Chromium for Playwright, and ffmpeg
- Python 3.11 or newer for the voice, intro and final stitch
- Optional: ElevenLabs (paid plan for client work) and Replicate accounts

## Downloads

- `webapp-capture-plugin-2.0.0.zip`: complete plugin for Claude Code, Cowork and the ChatGPT desktop app
- `webapp-capture-stinger-2.0.0.skill`: standalone capture skill for claude.ai
- `SHA256SUMS`: SHA-256 checksums for both artifacts

This prepares release artifacts and notes only. It does not publish a GitHub Release or create a tag.
